explication: DuckStation is a PlayStation emulator whose main user journey is selecting a game in a frontend, configuring or supplying BIOS and input, running the emulated system, and presenting video and audio. The graph preserves major README capabilities as product subsystems, including disc loading, rendering, controller input, save states, achievements, and alternate UI. Source excerpts cover only a few controllers, audio effects, and graphics pipelines, so most subsystem connections are shown as unverified rather than asserted as inspected call paths.
